clauses.statement: apply persists planned, applying, active, partial_failed, and manual_intervention_required states and resume skips completed steps.
clauses.rationale: Provisioning spans multiple durable systems and must be forward-resumable.

clauses.rationale: Canonical organization facts, personal workspace paths, repository creation, and content onboarding have different authorities and lifecycles.

clauses.statement: Project Provisioning has no production browser UI. The server-side session.create/static endpoint and Session Launch Picker are retired and unreachable. During migration, an old NocoDB START_TASK event may reach the retained FocusEngineModal only as a downstream compatibility consumer; engine selection (or a missing Modal) fails closed to a Codex migration notice and does not call session APIs. The retained Workspace Setup selector module owns explicit per-user local.path as a separate compatibility/contract surface, is not currently served by a production static route, and its synthetic-host test is not production browser E2E evidence. Codex app/CLI owns task and worktree creation.
clauses.rationale: Retired session creation must not remain a shadow Catalog or task-creation route; the legacy NocoDB compatibility path must not reach the retired API. Formal registration stays on Skill/CLI/API/MCP, personal workspace paths remain outside organization facts, and compatibility tests must not be reported as production UI evidence.

story_refs.text_snippet: Project Provisioningは本番ブラウザUIを持たない。保持されるWorkspace Setup selector moduleは、個人のlocal pathを扱う別Capabilityの互換・契約surfaceである
